name: Should I choose garage floor tile or an epoxy floor coating?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose garage floor tile or an epoxy floor coating?

acceptedAnswer.text: Porcelain floor tile is a permanent architectural finish that resists dropped tools, hot-tire pickup, and welding heat, whereas epoxy is a surface coating that can peel over time. A key tradeoff is initial investment: epoxy is faster and less expensive upfront, but heavy traffic, moisture vapor from below the slab, or hot tires frequently cause it to bubble and lift after a few years. Porcelain tile requires higher initial labor and surface leveling, but it delivers decades of service and provides a clean, finished look that mirrors your home’s interior.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain tile costs more initially but never peels from hot tires or moisture vapor, making it a more permanent solution than epoxy coatings.
